items.title: PM.S01 ('AcromymS') merges four real top-level TOC headings into one node
items.summary: toc_inventory.json's PM.S01 node (title an OCR garble of 'Acronyms') carries merged_duplicate_headings ['Palliative Approachto Care', 'Pain and Symptom Management'] and only two T-children (Palliative Care, Assessment Tools), implying a single 3-node section. Rendering the source PDF's own TOC page (pdf1299) and body pages PM2-PM4 (pdf1300-1302) confirms these are in fact four distinct top-level navy-banner headings: Acronyms (excluded, non-clinical), Palliative Approach to Care > Palliative Care (SU-PM-01), and Pain and Symptom Management > Assessment Tools (SU-PM-02) plus Pain and Symptom Management's own un-captured Table 2/WHO-ladder content (SU-PM-03, recovered under a synthetic UNCATALOGUED id).
items.recommended_action: Reviewer should confirm against the source PDF that the pdf1300-1302 (PM2-PM4) page boundaries assigned to SU-PM-01/02/03 are exactly correct.

items.title: Real 'Psychosocial and Spiritual Needs' heading absent from toc_inventory.json
items.summary: toc_inventory.json's PM.S02 node (title 'Care of the Dying Patient') carries the real, separate 'Psychosocial and Spiritual Needs' top-level heading in its merged_duplicate_headings field rather than as its own node. Body-confirmed via pdf1303 (PM5): both sections share the page, with 'Psychosocial and Spiritual Needs' as its own navy-banner heading in the bottom half. Recovered under a synthetic UNCATALOGUED:PsychosocialAndSpiritualNeeds@pdf1303 id.
items.recommended_action: Reviewer should confirm the pdf1303 (PM5) single-page assignment is correct and that no further sub-heading within this section was missed.

items.title: PM.S03.T02 ('Approach to Communicating Bad News') mis-parented under 'End-of-Life Decision Making'; real 'Communication' heading missing
items.summary: toc_inventory.json captures PM.S03.T02 as a child of PM.S03 ('End-of-Life Decision Making'), and folds the real, separate 'Communication' top-level heading into PM.S03's merged_duplicate_headings field. Body confirmation (pdf1304-1305, PM6-PM7) shows 'Communication' is T02's true immediate parent: the general communication-principles paragraph is directly followed by the SPIKES 'Approach to Communicating Bad News' sub-heading, then 'Estimating Life Expectancy' at the top of PM7 before 'Collaboration' begins. Re-parented under a synthetic UNCATALOGUED:Communication@pdf1304 id (SU-PM-07); PM.S03/PM.S03.T01 (Types of Discussions) remain correctly under End-of-Life Decision Making (SU-PM-06).
items.recommended_action: Reviewer should confirm the pdf1304-1305 (PM6-PM7) page boundary between End-of-Life Decision Making and Communication, and that 'Estimating Life Expectancy' is genuinely part of Communication rather than its own missing top-level heading.

items.title: Real 'Suffering' section (PM7-PM8) entirely absent from toc_inventory.json, garbled into PM.S04 as fragment 'Tn'
items.summary: toc_inventory.json's PM.S04 node (title 'Collaboration') carries the fragment 'Tn' in its merged_duplicate_headings field - an OCR garble that, cross-checked against the source PDF's own TOC page (pdf1299), corresponds to the real 'Suffering' top-level heading (the next heading after 'Collaboration', both starting PM7). No node of any kind exists for this heading or its ~275 words of substantive content (Definition, Sources of Suffering; Options to Relieve Refractory Physical Suffering including palliative sedation and dignity therapy; Options to Relieve Existential Suffering including MAID; Types of Grief), spanning pdf1305-1306 (PM7-PM8). Recovered under a synthetic UNCATALOGUED:Suffering@pdf1305 id and split into three study units (SU-PM-09 definition/sources/physical-suffering-relief, SU-PM-10 MAID, SU-PM-11 grief) since MAID and grief classification are independently testable topics rather than generic suffering-relief detail.
items.recommended_action: Reviewer should confirm against the source PDF that the pdf1305-1306 (PM7-PM8) page boundaries and the three-way SU-PM-09/10/11 split are correct, and that no sub-heading within the recovered section was missed.

items.title: Pediatric-Palliative-Care 'Assessment Tools' child heading absent from toc_inventory.json
items.summary: toc_inventory.json's PM.S06 node (title 'Pediatric Palliative Care') carries the real, separate 'Assessment Tools' child heading in its merged_duplicate_headings field rather than as its own T-child node (distinct from the earlier adult 'Assessment Tools' child of 'Pain and Symptom Management', PM.S01.T02/SU-PM-02). Recovered under a synthetic UNCATALOGUED:PediatricAssessmentTools@pdf1307 id (SU-PM-14).
items.recommended_action: Reviewer should confirm the pdf1307 (PM9) single-page assignment is correct.

items.title: End-of-Life Decision Making, Communication/SPIKES, and MAID substantially overlap ELOM
items.summary: SU-PM-06 (Advance Care Planning/Goals of Care/Code Status) shares its Ontario default-SDM/Power-of-Attorney legal machinery with ELOM's Consent and Capacity unit (MCC 121-1), and the chapter itself explicitly redirects POA mechanics to ELOM15. SU-PM-07 (Communication/SPIKES) shares its general truth-telling/bad-news-disclosure ethical principle with ELOM's Truth Telling unit (MCC 121-2). SU-PM-10 (MAID) is foundational to ELOM's end-of-life legal/ethical content generally. Per project instruction (matching the OR/OP/OB/OT precedent and this task's explicit ELOM/PM boundary guidance), PRIMARY_OWNER/CROSS_LINK/DISTINCT_CONTEXT designation across all three is deferred to a later global cross-chapter ownership audit; each unit's cross_discipline_note documents the specific overlap and the clinical-application-vs-general-principle distinction used to avoid outright duplication.
items.recommended_action: Defer to global cross-chapter ownership audit; no chapter-local action required. Reviewer may wish to confirm ELOM's existing Consent/Capacity and Truth Telling units do not already claim palliative-specific content (SPIKES, MAID eligibility pathways, code-status terminology) that would make these PM units redundant rather than complementary.

items.title: MCC Objectives registry has no dedicated palliative-care, spiritual-assessment, grief, or pediatric-palliative objective
items.summary: A full-registry search-mcc-objectives sweep for 'palliative', 'goals of care', 'MAID', 'prognosis', 'grief', 'spiritual', 'psychosocial', 'advance care planning', 'communication skills', and related terms returned zero direct matches beyond obj25 ('Dying patients') and obj121-2 ('Truth telling'). As in prior chapters (OT's ENT-presentation gap, OR's fracture gap), the registry lacks a dedicated 'palliative care' or 'goals of care' objective distinct from the dying-patient objective; content earlier or broader than the dying-patient scope (early palliative referral timing, assessment-tool selection, spiritual assessment, grief classification, pediatric palliative care) is instead mapped to obj25 with MODERATE evidence strength rather than STRONG, consistent with project accuracy rules (no invented MCC IDs; evidence strength reflects the actual degree of match).
items.recommended_action: None required at this stage - consistent with project accuracy rules. Coordinator may wish to note, in a future cross-chapter registry-gap audit, that the MCC Objectives registry anchors essentially all of palliative medicine's non-MAID, non-symptom-control content to a single dying-patient objective (25), despite this chapter's real scope (early palliative referral, spiritual/psychosocial assessment, grief, pediatric palliative care) extending meaningfully beyond a strictly dying patient.

items.title: Depth calls flagged for optional human confirmation: pediatric assessment-instrument names, landmark-trials table
items.summary: Per the project's generalist-vs-specialist depth guidance, named pediatric symptom-screening instruments (SSPedi/Mini-SSPedi/MSAS, SU-PM-14) and the chapter's EBM landmark-trials summary table (SU-PM-17) were classified SPECIALIST_DETAIL/REFERENCE_ONLY with zero minimum question coverage, consistent with the OT audiometric-instrument and general reference-table precedents. These are judgment calls rather than clear-cut exclusions.
items.recommended_action: Human reviewer may wish to confirm these depth calls, particularly whether basic recognition that SSPedi vs. Mini-SSPedi differ by age band belongs at COMPONENT rather than SPECIALIST_DETAIL depth.
